page_title: CAG 2-1 SAS | Cagliari v Sassuolo 11/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+9' 2 - 1 GOAL! But maybe a bit lucky, as a miscued scissor kick inside the box from Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) squirms into the net somehow. That changes the score to 2:1.

90+6' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
90+5' Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo) is booked.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
90+4' 1 - 1 Goal! Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:1.
90+3' Cagliari force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
90+2' Marco Mancosu (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tommaso Augello.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Prati leaves the pitch and Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) comes on.
90+1' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Sassuolo players look gutted.
90+1' Attention! Referee Maurizio Mariani straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) has a goal ruled out for offside!
88' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) meets a cross and produces a header towards the middle of the net, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
83' The ball goes out of play and Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick.
82' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) commits a foul after dangerous play.
81' Alessio Dionisi has decided to make a change. Cristian Volpato (Sassuolo) replaces Uros Racic.
81' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Andrea Pinamonti walks off the pitch to be replaced by Samuele Mulattieri (Sassuolo).
74' Substitution. Eldor Shomurodov (Cagliari) has come on for Gaetano Oristanio.
74' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes.
73' Alessio Dionisi is forced to make a change. Matias Vina is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo).
69' Andrea Consigli (Sassuolo) goes into the book and receives a yellow card.
68' Cagliari enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
65' Alessio Dionisi prepares a substitution. Armand Lauriente is replaced by Marcus Pedersen (Sassuolo).
65' The referee allows time for a substitution. Samu Castillejo will be replaced by Gian Marco Ferrari (Sassuolo).
63' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
62' Cagliari force a corner. They send men into the box.
61' The corner is swung in but Cagliari can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Nahitan Nandez goes off the pitch and Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) comes on.
59' Claudio Ranieri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) replacing Ibrahim Sulemana.
56' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
55' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

52' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Maurizio Mariani with no other option than to blow for a foul.

49' A fine move culminates with a precision cross onto the head of Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) in the centre of the box. It's a good attempt but goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
49' Cagliari seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
47' The game is interrupted as Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is flagged offside.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
43' Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
41' Great teamplay by Sassuolo as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
38' The corner by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

37' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sassuolo.
36' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
36' Ruan Tressoldi (Sassuolo) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
32' 50:50 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
29' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
29' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
28' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' The Cagliari players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

20' Matteo Prati (Cagliari) wastes a great chance from the resulting corner. He times his header superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross, but can't aim better than into the middle of the goal, straight into the arms of the goalkeeper.
19' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) steps up to send the ball in.
16' Sassuolo are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
15' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.

13' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) missed a great opportunity! He jumped for a cross and headed towards goal from the penalty spot, but the ball sailed well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Sassuolo will have a goal kick.
12' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) takes it short.
11' Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Yellow card! It's like Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Maurizio Mariani agrees and books him.

7' 0 - 1 Martin Erlic (Sassuolo) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 0:1.
7' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) will take the corner.
6' The resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) comes to nothing.
6' Sassuolo work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

5' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) leaps highest to meet a cross and steers a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a crucial save to thwart the effort. Sassuolo have been awarded a corner kick.
4' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
3' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Simone Scuffet.
2' Edoardo Goldaniga (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Cagliari will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani will referee today's match.
